final.ate_protocol: entire reconstructed trajectory of every record, including tails; initial translation only; no intermediate reset, rotation or scale fitting; per-record RMSE then equal-weight record mean
final.rte_protocol: all legal 30-second endpoint pairs within full records; record-balanced RMSE mean; includes record tails
final.displacement_protocol: pooled vector RMSE of full-horizon predictions on every update; overlapping outputs included; includes record tails

early.ate_protocol: entire reconstructed trajectory of every record, including tails; initial translation only; no intermediate reset, rotation or scale fitting; per-record RMSE then equal-weight record mean
early.rte_protocol: all legal 30-second endpoint pairs within full records; record-balanced RMSE mean; includes record tails
early.displacement_protocol: pooled vector RMSE of full-horizon predictions on every update; overlapping outputs included; includes record tails

note: Full-data results belong to the legacy trained checkpoint. New half-second update model checked using a small-data execution checkpoint only.
